Hi, {name}! 👋

I'm **SDU Hub**, your student-life assistant. I can help you check deadlines, find a free room and discover campus events.

**📚 Study**
/deadline — Moodle assignment deadlines
/grade — your grades
/guide — how to create your course schedule

**🏫 Campus**
/events — university events
/rooms — free classrooms
You can also choose a time: /rooms 14:30

**🎓 Enrollment**
/documents — submit your enrollment documents

**⚙️ Settings**
/login — sign in with your university ID
/lang — Қазақша / Русский / English
/help — all commands and help

💬 Have a question? Just type it:
“How do I create my schedule?”

Choose a button below to get started 👇
